notes.title: 💀 THE WALLWAY – EARLY ACCESS RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT!

notes.title: New co-op Horror Game BloodLight is coming!
notes.content:
Hello there!
This month we plan to launch early access to our new co-op horror game BloodLight. The game is very realistic, you will play as a night watchman who must complete all his tasks in order to leave the spooky and atmospheric warehouse. You will go alone or with your friends against a really aggressive demon that changes its forms and tries to kill you!

More info: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950190/BloodLight/

Official Teaser Trailer: [previewyoutube=WeK3_jYv_T0;full][/previewyoutube]

When will the game be released?

 We are planning to release BloodLight Early Access in the middle of this month. 

How much will the game cost?

 Early access will cost $15 and the initial discount will be 35%. Once the full game is released, the game will be priced at $5.

Will there be a demo?

 Yes, we plan to make a demo available a few days after the early access release.

When will the full version be released?

 We plan for the Early Access to last for a month, and in the meantime the game will be fully completed and then the full version will be released

Thank you for your support! 
- Team Galactic Games

notes.title: Preparatory Patch for DLC
notes.content:
Preparatory Patch for DLC

Preparatory Patch for DLC contains preparatory elements for activation and connection with DLC's. It also contains minor bug fixes and map adjustments.

What does the Preparatory Patch for DLC contain?
Preparation for DLC - This preparation is informational only and has no graphic design. Everything will be added in the future.

Map modifications - There have been some minor changes and modifications to the map. 

Changes - The end game has been simplified and the hitboxes of some of the slugs have been changed or removed completely.

Minor bug fixes - There were a couple of bugs in the game that this smell fixes.

You can look forward to the first DLC and free bonus maps coming soon.

notes.title: Revenguard - Galactic Patch 1.0.97
notes.content:
What does Galactic Patch 1.0.97 contain?

- Map changes
- Every object that can kill you now has inconspicuous red particles around it so you can tell what can kill you and what can't.

- Graphical changes to widgets
- All text buttons for the widgets listed are now red with a black border. So that you can distinguish the button from the text. Changes have been made in the following widgets: Stats Widget, Controller Settings Widget, Options Widget. The other buttons in the game have not been changed.

- Removed things
- Darkening in caves has been removed due to issues. It will be added back in the next patch 1.1.
- Dramatic song on two slugs after the first cave, has been removed due to an issue. It will not be added back in the next patch 1.1.
- Some items on the map have been removed due to issues. They will not be added back in the next patch 1.1.

- Bug fixes
- Several small bugs have been fixed in the game. 

In case of any problems, please contact us.

notes.title: Revenguard - Galactic Patch 1.0.95
notes.content:
What does Galactic Patch 1.0.95 contain?

- Fix moveing animation in main menu
The menu is made so that the forest spawns over the camera. Since Galactic Patch 1.0.79 this spawning has stopped working.

Reduced spawn rate of falling stalactites from 2-6s to 4-10s.
Jumps on the entire map have been lightened.

- Increased the amount of checkpoints on the map.
Classic mode: from 9 to 14
Hard mode: from 5 to 8
Extreme mode: left without checkpoints (no adjustments)

- Added background music

notes.title: We're offering you free early access to our Revenguard game!
notes.content:
Hello!
We would like to offer you free early access to our latest game Revenguard.

Revenguard game description:
Revenguard is set in the ancient past in the territory of the kingdom of Revenguard. Your mission is to rescue your best friend who has been kidnapped by very hostile slimes who want to conquer the kingdom of Revenguard and take over the world. Rescuing your little dog will not be easy. Your best friend is being held in a castle that has already been taken over by the slimeballs. This is also where the slime lord is hiding. But getting there can be challenging. Along the way, you'll have to solve various tasks, jump from tree to tree, climb mountains or crawl through creepy caves, and most importantly, avoid the slimes who will try to kill you as soon as they see you. Good luck, the Revenguard Kingdom needs you!

Interested in our product?
"Revenguard" will be available on Steam at the end of August. So if you are interested in free early access to "Revenguard", contact us at this email address: galacticgames.business@gmail.com and we will provide you with a key to our game "Revenguard" in exchange for streaming, making a video or any kind of promotion of our game.

Have fun playing and have a galactic day!

- Galactic Games Team
